name: Cloudsphere
description:
About This Game

Take to the skies.

Cloudsphere is a tactical roguelike deckbuilder where the layout of your flying ship dictates your hand of cards. Assemble a modular fortress of cannons, coolers, and arcane tech, then chart a course across the seven skies. Command your crew, fire devastating barrages, and uncover infinite synergies to survive.

Your Ship is Your Deck

Every block you bolt onto your ship directly changes your combat capabilities and adds specific Captain's Orders to your deck.

  • Build & Modify: Loot scrap and ancient tech to constantly evolve your vessel. Place weapons, utilities, and defenses on a tactical grid.

  • Endless Synergies: Place adjacent blocks to forge massive, game-changing combos.

  • Overclock Your Ship: Push your ship to the absolute limit. Manage your heat gauge carefully: adding, upgrading, and overclocking your modules can turn you into an unstoppable juggernaut, or burn your ship to cinders.

Tactical Grid Combat

Combat is a deadly dance of positioning and resource management.

  • Order Your Crewmates: Your crew represents your action points. Order them to jump across the deck to fire cannons, repair armor, or vent heat.

  • Play Your Hand: Draw from your dynamically generated deck of Captain's Orders to unleash devastating combos alongside your crew's actions.

  • Dodge & Weave: Read enemy telegraphs and physically maneuver your massive ship out of the line of fire.

  • Call forth the storm: Use the weather to damage your enemies, and yourself!

A Hostile Horizon

  • Hunt Leviathans: Fight off opportunistic pirates, survive violent storms, and hunt colossal, screen-filling sky-leviathans.

  • Choose Your Path: Navigate a dynamic map from beacon to beacon, scouting and changing your path ahead into encounters that suit your build.

  • Unlock the Fortress: Return to the Flying Fortress between runs. Unlock new ships, discover new modules, and recruit completely different captains, each completely altering your starting playstyle.
short_desc: A roguelike deckbuilder where your ship is your deck. Build modular sky-vessels block by block - every module you install adds a card to your captain's deck. Overclocks, synergies, three layers of cloud-bound world, and the leviathan that destroyed your home.
